method: Exhaustive truth-table authoring; independently checked with the in-house DPLL. Multi-clue steps hold all previously proved statuses fixed.
conditional_policy: At its reveal in the row-major review path, a premise must be undecided. An implication must not collapse to either of its two sides. Each case includes a usable contraposition. The two sides admit all four truth combinations without the implication. Relational clues additionally admit all four combinations at reveal; reverse clues have a known-false consequence and an undecided premise.
opening_policy: Opening certificates use only revealed clues, count bounds and an opposite-verdict assumption; one additional two-way case split is allowed. This is a mechanical review, not a claim of human playtesting. All opening conditionals have both sides unresolved; 3x3 openings need no additional case split.
source_hash_algorithm: SHA256 of puzzle JSON file bytes
